reason: Conversation 2 gave a correctly hedged differential (jockey pulley vs drum supports vs trapped item), ran sensible owner-safe checks with unplug instructions, adapted when the customer couldn't lift the drum or tilt the machine, gave clear stop-use conditions, and ended with a well-justified engineer recommendation plus a useful symptom summary. Conversation 1 was safe and ended in the same engineer escalation, but it asked for the model number specifically to 'match the right part' then admitted it couldn't, offered a thin diagnosis, never checked levelling or noise location, and gave no guidance on continued use or warning signs.
